criteria.rationale: Independent Codex review by another vendor than agent:claude-opus-5-5. The agent: prefix is a declaration required by the engine, not verified identity. The maintainer authorized agent:independent-gpt-6.1-sol-review. Pinned signing keys remain trusted authorities; native sealing refuses after adoption and rechecks history.

Optional legacy ledgers extend unsigned history verification without weakening live signing for uncovered attestations. Direct and answered-request adoption honor explicit issuer selection and share sealing. Signed envelopes are unaffected.

D1 binds exact prior content rather than a date exemption; D2 puts sealing before policy activation in the single adopt contract. Full SHA256 content and Ed25519 signature prevent entry injection and same-ID content substitution.

Rules applied during review: mixed feature and bugfix; workflow .pose/workflows/review.md; backend-go for Go errors and tests, security for pins signatures and paths, documentation-style for CLI and issuer guidance, delivery-evidence for closeout. No UI or infrastructure rules apply. docs-site/docs/cli.md and help match native behavior.

Missing or ambiguous local issuers give init/pin or --issuer remediation. Both previews do not write ledgers. Independent failure injection left a signed ledger with policy disabled; retry reused coverage without duplicating it. Invalid ledgers fail closed.

Reviewed all four attributed commits from 9fedf820 through 73efabb4 against R1-R6; declared artifacts reconcile and delivery composition passes. No unrelated refactor or dependency added. Prior four findings have regression coverage and pass.

Cheapest bypass is injecting a new ledger or changing an entry: without pinned key a valid Ed25519 signature is unavailable. LegacyLedgerRefusesEverythingOutsideIt and SealingRechecksAndRefusesSymlinkedDir exercise refusals; extra ephemeral probes passed for same-ID modified content, unsigned injected ledger, file symlink and FIFO. Another project and unpinned keys are refused. Corpus README has no dedicated ledger case; equivalent focused negative tests provide this evidence. A holder of the trusted pinned key can sign manually, the existing attestation authority boundary. Diff secret-pattern scan found no matches; no dependency change.

Smallest sufficient alternative retaining live signatures is an exact signed set. Date cutoffs permit later forged history; rereviewing all history imposes avoidable cost. No separate sealing command or extensibility added. Choice would need reassessment if pinned issuers were no longer trusted signing authorities.
